title: Big Bird: Transformers for Longer Sequences
authors: M. Zaheer, G. Guruganesh, A. Dubey, et al. (11 authors)
before: Sparse attention patterns were designed by hand with no guarantee they preserved expressiveness.
problem: Does a sparse pattern still let information flow between any two positions?
breakthrough: Global, window and random attention combined, with a proof that the result is a universal approximator of full attention.
why: It gave the sparse-attention family a theoretical footing as well as a practical one.
next: Superseded in practice by exact methods once FlashAttention made full attention cheap.
inherits: The vocabulary of global, local and random attention patterns.
